label: Do possibilities need a mind? Conceptualism and non-real plurality at a simple root (#2145 lane H1)
summary: See docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md, section 'Do possibilities need a mind? Conceptualism and non-real plurality at a simple root'. Horizontal family under the three-angles rule, after lane C rounds 2 and 3 (attempts 421caba9, 6429463e) left d1fb6414 at parity with A4. (1) The brief's conceptualist form (aboutness, intrinsic or derived, mental) was tested against Platonism, ersatz worlds, Lewisian and Meinongian or Zalta-style possibilia, cognitive-act theories, powers-based modality and A4 at the root's scope: every independent-realm account lands on horn 1 (65805e5a), cognitive-act theories leave no pre-creation stand-ins, factive relations cannot stand for non-present candidates (both sides), and derived aboutness reduces to the in-source case. (2) Derived the shared demand (Lean-only simpleBearerHasNonRealStandIn, zero axioms): a constitutively simple bearer with a good-general favouring and no present candidates has a stand-in in it that is not a real constituent; realStandInsGiveNoGoodGeneralFavouring answers question C: real Molnar-type directed powers, and real ideas, cannot supply the distinct stand-ins at a simple patientless root. (3) Registered 19d5872a (simpleRootGoodGeneralFavouringIsApprehension, zero axioms): lane C's five individuation premises, root simplicity f4180d0c, no present candidates fce9e0a3, the conceptualist premise cde7f1dd (non-real contained items are apprehended by their bearer; related to, but not a consequence of, the dictum that beings of reason have being only in an intellect) and the content premise 5a3a1432 give the root cognition criterion b371638a; 83b91c73 verifies that 3b40009e strengthens b371638a; 419e24af composes b371638a with 7fca65ec and 980e6482 into 3a32d91c, a route that uses neither 3b40009e nor d1fb6414 but re-presents the same dispute rather than adding evidence: A4 holds every premise except cde7f1dd, the instances the route uses are also instances of d1fb6414, and it shares lane C's five premises. Comparator companions possibiliaControls (single failures of each new premise: A4 modes, real plurality, template reading, present inputs) and rootCriterionWithoutConceptualism. (4) Relocation probe: restricted to the route the conceptualist premise is equivalent to the conclusion given the rest; the general premise is strictly stronger. (5) Same-criterion payment table and a domain survey (negations, possibilia, propositions, relations to non-existents, distinctions within one thing). (6) After an independent semantic challenge of 95077bd33 (itemized findings not preserved), wording and records were repaired: the relation to the dictum, the A3 value-dependence sentence, the relocation caveat on the route through 419e24af, the global form of fce9e0a3, the instance standard of table D, the evidence boundary of named authors, the control-row artifacts and the unlinked senses of simple (recorded for #216). No Lean statement or proof changed.
blocker: Parity at the status step. Both sides must posit a non-real plurality in one simple nature with no established instance of its kind outside the root: objects of one real act of understanding (personal; human distinctions of reason are carried by real plural representations) versus mind-independent formal distinctions a parte rei (A4; the Scotist precedent is contested by Ockham's identity objection). The domain-general record of the conceptualist premise does not discriminate: mind-independent accounts elsewhere use an independent realm, eliminate the items, or make them real items of composite bearers; induction from identified non-real items faces a selection effect. A4 in its template form (no aboutness, no apprehension) denies the conceptualist and content premises with no further identified price.

current_assessment.scope: Horizontal family (#2145 lane H1): whether individuated, value-ranked possibilities need a mind, assessed at a constitutively simple root with no present candidates, comparing the personal payment (objects of one act of understanding) and A4's (mind-independent non-real modes) under one criterion.
current_assessment.assessment: Parity. The shared demand is now derived for both sides (a non-real contained stand-in; real ideas and real directed powers are both excluded at a simple patientless root). The conceptualist premise cde7f1dd with the content premise gives the root criterion and a new conditional route to 3a32d91c that bypasses 3b40009e and d1fb6414, but it re-presents the same dispute and adds no evidence; against A4 it is a relocation: restricted to the route the premise is equivalent to the conclusion given the rest, and its domain-general record (negations, possibilia, propositions, relations to non-existents, distinctions within one thing) does not discriminate it from A4's denial. Neither payment has an established instance outside the root; each faces a disputed objection (Euthyphro for ideas; Ockham's identity objection to formal distinction). Non-factive aboutness is established for human minds only as carried by real representations, as directedness in powers is carried by real powers, so it gives no asymmetry at a simple root; A4 in its template form also denies aboutness. The conceptualist premise is not a consequence of the classical dictum: it drops the dependence, indexes apprehension to the containing bearer and ranges over every non-real contained item. No change in the cognition criterion's overall warrant.
current_assessment.next_test: 1. Truthmakers for the modes: what in the one real nature makes these non-real items distinct; if they are individuated by limits, the plurality is one of negations (joins lane H2 on negative profile facts). 2. Ockham's objection without begging the question: real identity and formal non-identity as distinct relations, applied identically to A4's modes and to ideas really identical with the essence. 3. Explanatory use of the modes beyond favouring that requires them to be for the source. 4. The dictum-faithful sibling: apprehension by some apprehender, with an explicit root bridge that nothing other than the root can apprehend an item contained in it before production. 5. A pair-restricted form of fce9e0a3, if the shared signature gains a pair-restricted present-input relation.
